label: Creator / education business
description: A channel or newsletter that brings an audience in, and a course, community or membership that earns.

departments.name: Marketing
departments.owns: Content, distribution and lead capture: everything that brings strangers in
departments.intro: Turn attention into people who join the list or the community.

departments.name: Sales
departments.owns: Turning an audience member into a paying customer: the offer, the page, the follow-up

departments.name: Product
departments.owns: The course, community or membership itself
departments.intro: Make what people paid for worth it.

departments.name: Customer
departments.intro: Find out why people stay or leave.

departments.name: Finance
departments.owns: Revenue, expenses, pricing and the monthly close

metrics.name: Audience size
metrics.definition: Followers or subscribers on the main channel. Cumulative: read the change.

metrics.name: Email subscribers
metrics.definition: People you can email. The audience you own.

metrics.name: Paying customers
metrics.definition: People currently paying for your offer.

metrics.name: MRR
metrics.definition: Recurring revenue this month, net of tax, cash basis.

metrics.name: Monthly revenue
metrics.definition: Everything collected this month: recurring plus one-time sales.

metrics.name: Monthly expenses
metrics.definition: Everything paid out this month: tools, ads, contractors.
